description: ORNL 2004 Prius Phase B (#69): blind no-load back-EMF correlation with sourced sensitivity bands. Exploratory hardware correlation; no pass/fail.
targets: target-back-emf.json (ORNL/TM-2006/423 Table 3.4, terminal line-to-line volts, oil at a nominal 25 degC)

run.tool: tools/experimental_solve.py (experimental HoleM50 path; no qualification claim)
run.solver_settings: as the frozen request: normal mesh, Newton, WST torque, 7.5 deg mechanical steps

conversion: Native phase waveforms are line-to-neutral volts at the solved speed (3000 rpm).
Line-to-line = phase A - phase B, sampled on the registered electrical-angle grid.
RMS over one electrical period; peak = largest sampled absolute value.
No-load back-EMF scales linearly with speed from the solved speed.
ORNL Table 3.4 values are motor-terminal line-to-line volts (owner decision, 2026-10-14).

all-bands-with-9-turns.note: Every band at the endpoint that lowers the back-EMF, multiplied together; interactions are ignored, so this is approximate

all-bands-with-8-turns.note: Every band at the endpoint that lowers the back-EMF, multiplied together; interactions are ignored, so this is approximate

ornl_implied_flux_linkage.assumption: sinusoidal fundamental: lambda = sqrt(2) * E_LL_rms / sqrt(3) / omega_e

stated_not_solved.magnet_temperature: Assumed equal to the 25 degC oil; about -0.1 %/K for each kelvin warmer. No measured magnet temperature exists.
stated_not_solved.end_effects: 2D at the 83.82 mm stack. The audit's 1-3% allowance is included in the combined envelopes at 3%.
stated_not_solved.skew: Assumed none; S4's rotor photographs were not inspected for skew. A skew would lower the fundamental by about 1-2%.
stated_not_solved.steel_grade: Not run: Magneto2D has one steel curve (M350-50A, 0.5 mm). The audit asks for two 0.35 mm grades; no sourced curve is available.
stated_not_solved.magnet_condition: The tested motor was used; its magnets' condition is unknown.
